d.name: Prince of Persia®
d.desc: The critically acclaimed Prince of Persia® franchise returns for the first time on next-generation platforms with an all-new epic journey. Built by the same award-winning Ubisoft Montreal studio that created Assassin's Creed™, Prince of Persia has been in development for over three years to deliver a whole new action-adventure gaming...
min: Dual core processor 2.6 GHz Intel® Pentium® D or AMD Athlon™ 64 X2 3800+ (Intel Core® 2 Duo 2.2 GHz or AMD Athlon 64 X2 4400+ or better recommended)
1 GB Windows XP/2 GB Windows Vista
256 MB DirectX® 10.0–compliant video card or DirectX 9.0–compliant card with Shader Model 3.0 or higher (see supported list)*
DirectX 9.0 or 10.0–compliant sound card (5.1 sound card recommended)
d.blurb:
Prince of Persia from 2008 is a reboot of the series by Ubisoft Montreal. A wandering adventurer meets Elika, a princess with magical powers, and the two set out to heal a land being swallowed by a dark corruption after an ancient evil god is released. You climb, wall-run and leap across ruins in a painterly, cel-shaded world, cleansing regions one by one.

Elika stays at your side and saves you from deadly falls, so the game is forgiving and keeps you moving. Combat is one-on-one duels. It is a single-player action adventure suited to players who enjoy acrobatic exploration and a relaxed pace.
